title: ἐάν conditions
subtitle: Read an open future condition with the subjunctive.
overview: ἐάν commonly introduces an open condition; its clause normally contains a subjunctive in Koine Greek.
Read ἐάν as if/whenever in the situation envisaged; do not reduce it to a mechanical probability label.

sections.title: Open-condition signals
rows: If you believe, you will see
If anyone wishes, let him follow

items.en: If it does not die, it remains alone.

items.grc: ἐὰν τὰς ἐντολάς μου τηρήσητε, μενεῖτε ἐν τῇ ἀγάπῃ μου.
items.en: If you keep my commandments, you will remain in my love.
